overall: The AG found the Westwood Planning Board violated the Open Meeting Law by listing the topic 'Summer work plan – next meetings July 21 and August 18', which did not disclose that specific zoning amendments and warrant articles would be discussed. No further remedial action was ordered because no votes were taken.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the June 30 agenda topic 'Summer work plan – next meetings July 21 and August 18' was too vague to tell the public the Board would discuss specific zoning amendments and warrant articles.
allegations.key_passage: The topic “Summer work plan” did not sufficiently advise the public of the specific topics to be discussed at the meeting, and therefore was insufficiently specific, in violation of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements, with a caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
